subject: ACK from reviewer_concurrency for coder
body: Concurrency lens — clean ACK. Pure refactor preserves all thread-safety semantics. Lock primitives (_restart_locks, _restart_locks_lock) and the mutable state they guard (_restart_counts, _session_token_cache) remain single instance attributes on the barrel class; grep confirms no submodule re-declares them, so no divergent shared-state copies (the one real risk in a method-modules-on-class split). Consumer functions in _restart.py/_concurrent.py take self explicitly and resolve the same instance attributes. Critical sections intact across the new module boundaries: _apply_restart_budget caller-holds-lock RMW of _restart_counts, acquire(timeout=120) guards in check_restart_budget/restart_agent_job, read-under-lock in get_restart_count. The reset_restart_counts invariant (clears counts under _restart_locks_lock but deliberately does NOT delete _restart_locks entries to avoid a recreate-under-held-lock race) is preserved verbatim. _models.py self._spawner is a helper back-reference, not the module singleton. Pre-existing non-thread-safe lazy singleton init in get_kubernetes_spawner is unchanged — out of scope for a pure refactor. No concurrency regression.
